items.title: Exxonmobil in talks to return to Venezuela, Bloomberg reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation (NYSE:XOM) is in active negotiations to re-enter Venezuela, according to a report from Bloomberg, as the Texas oil titan weighs a high-stakes return to the nation holding the world’s largest crude reserves. Senior executives traveled to Caracas this week to discuss securing rights to four heavy-oil fields, including two Orinoco Belt assets, Petrovictoria and Petromonagas, that were nationalized under former President Hugo Chávez.
